description: One large knob whose position is the output, with four stored settings it slides to over a set time

params.text: Sets the output voltage, 0 to 1 before the scale and offset knobs are applied
Stores the knob's present position into that preset, and a second press clears it again
Starts a slide from wherever the knob is to that stored preset, over that preset's time
Sets that preset's slide time, 0 to 1 multiplied by the scale switch above it
Bends that preset's slide away from a straight line, -1 to 1; at 0 the slide is linear, positive settings start slowly and negative settings start quickly
Multiplies that preset's slide time by 1, 10 or 100
Multiplies the knob position before the offset is added, -10 to 10
Adds -10V to 10V to the output after the scale has been applied

inputs.text: Scales the knob position; with a cable here the knob reads as a share of this voltage rather than of one volt
A rising edge here starts a slide to that preset
Sets that preset's slide time in seconds, multiplied by the scale switch, and overrides that preset's time knob while patched

outputs.text: Carries the knob position, multiplied by the scale knob with the offset added
Carries the difference between the output and the value the knob would give at its top, which makes a mirror of the output
Sends a 1ms pulse when a slide to that preset finishes

notes: a Go button or jack does nothing until that preset has been stored: press its small set button first, and the small orange lamp beside it lights for a preset that holds something
moving the big knob during a slide stops the slide where it is
menu: Global End of Cycle — sends every preset's finished pulse from the first end of cycle jack
Separate End of Cycles — sends each preset's finished pulse from its own jack, and is the setting the module comes up in
Ignore retriggers — a second Go on the preset already running is ignored
Retrigger stops cycle — a second Go on the preset already running stops the slide where it is
Retrigger restarts cycle — a second Go on the preset already running starts the slide again from the knob's present position
